Join phenotype observations with environmental records

Source: R/functional_environment.R
pheno_weather_join.Rd

Join phenotype observations with environmental records

Usage

pheno_weather_join(
  phenotypes,
  weather,
  pheno_time,
  weather_time,
  by = NULL,
  method = c("exact", "nearest"),
  tolerance = Inf
)

Arguments

phenotypes

Phenotype data frame.

weather

Environmental/weather data frame.

pheno_time

Phenotype time column.

weather_time

Weather time column.

by

Additional exact join keys, such as environment.

method

"exact" or "nearest".

tolerance

Maximum nearest-time difference; Inf by default.

Value

Joined data frame with weather columns.

Examples

p <- subset(pheno_data("growth_series"), trait=="leaf_area")
w <- pheno_data("weather_series")
pheno_weather_join(p,w,"day","day",by="environment")
